Heavy Rains Cause Flooding and Disrupt Life Across India

Several parts of India are experiencing severe rainfall, leading to widespread flooding, school closures, and disruptions. Regions like Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and parts of Chhattisgarh have been particularly affected, with authorities issuing warnings and taking measures to manage the crisis. The heavy monsoon activity has transformed from providing relief to causing significant damage and posing risks to life and property.
